empty: No courses have been added yet. Create one with the + button.

name.label: Name
name.helper: The course appears under this name in the list.

group.label: Group
group.helper: The course belongs to this training group. You cannot change it later.

responsible.title: Responsible persons
responsible.description: They see the amounts and request the compensation. The first person gets the task to close the course when it ends.

trainers.title: Trainers
trainers.description: They confirm who was present at each session.

profile.label: Reporting profile
profile.helper: Sets the form in which attendance is reported when the course ends.

courseNumber.label: J+S offer number
courseNumber.helper: Only shown, and used in the file name of the report.

userGroup.label: User group (NG)
userGroup.helper: The user group of your J+S offer.

category.label: Main sport category
category.helper: Art. 1 para. 1 or 2 of the J+S ordinance of the BASPO. Only combinations that J+S knows are offered.

typeMapping.title: Session types
typeMapping.description: Assign the matching J+S activity to each session type. Sessions without an assignment are not reported.

finance.title: Trainer compensation
finance.intro: Only the responsible persons, the group leaders and the treasurers see these details.

books.label: Books
books.helper: The compensation is booked in these books.
books.none: No books are available. Ask your treasurer.

account.label: Expense account
account.helper: Leave empty to use the account from the settings of the books.

costCenter.label: Cost center
costCenter.helper: Leave empty to use the default of the account or of the books.

defaultRate.label: Rate per session ({currency})
defaultRate.helper: Applies to everyone entitled who has no rate of their own.

eligible.title: Entitled persons
eligible.description: These persons receive compensation for the sessions they led.

ownRate.label: Own rate
ownRate.helper: Without an own rate, the rate per session from above applies.

validation.endBeforeStart: The last day is before the first day.
validation.responsibleRequired: Choose at least one responsible person.
validation.jsPairInvalid: J+S does not know this combination of user group and main sport category.
validation.booksRequired: Choose the books in which the compensation is booked.
validation.booksUnknown: You cannot use these books. Choose another.
validation.rateInvalid: Enter an amount of 0 or more.
validation.duplicatePerson: Each person can be listed only once.
validation.personRequired: Choose the person from the list of persons.

list.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive this course? Its events are kept.
list.noGroup: This course list has no group. Open it from a group calendar.
list.financeUnavailable: The compensation details could not be loaded. The course opens without them. Please try again later.

yearly.title: Compensation per year
yearly.intro: Sum of the released compensation per person and calendar year, across all courses. The booking date decides.
yearly.empty: There is no released compensation yet.
yearly.error: The yearly totals could not be loaded.
